subject: Summer data anonymity pilot — request for supplemental credits / stipend
messages:
From: Dr. Aisha Banerjee <aisha@open-civic.org>
To: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-09-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: small top-up for summer de-identification pilot

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the credits you granted earlier this summer — the team at Open Civic Data Lab is almost through our first pass of automated de-identification, but we ran into higher-than-expected token volume during the redaction step. We estimate ~120k documents (~3M tokens) total and need an additional ~50k credits (~25k model-infer tokens + validation passes) to finish the last 2 weeks of the pilot.

Quick context: this pilot is funded by a municipal grant and must submit results to the city by Oct 20. We can accept either an on-platform promo credit or a small stipend (purchase order/credit) that we spend with Redwood.

Can Redwood approve a 50k credit top-up or equivalent stipend and a 30–60 day trial extension? We also need a simple statement that data will not be used to improve models (for the grant paperwork).

Attached: IRB_summary.docx (overview of handling and consent).

Appreciate any quick guidance — deadline is tight.

Best,
Aisha
Dr. Aisha Banerjee
Principal Investigator, Open Civic Data Lab

From: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Banerjee <aisha@open-civic.org>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-09-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: small top-up for summer de-identification pilot

Hi Aisha — thanks for the note and the IRB summary. Short answer: we can usually support supplemental credits for verified nonprofit research pilots, but need a quick internal check (compliance + finance) and a brief usage plan from you so we can document the extension.

Proposed next steps:
- Monica, can you confirm an appropriate promo amount and whether a 30 or 60 day extension makes sense operationally?
- Ben, FYI for outreach reporting / PR (may be interested in a short case blurb)
- Laura, any partnership discount we can apply on top?

Aisha, could you reply with: 1) expected additional token consumption (approx), 2) which model(s) you used, 3) confirmation you accept the Data Processing Addendum (I can attach a one-page statement that data won’t be used to improve models). If you prefer a stipend instead of credits, say so and we’ll route it to finance.

I’ll hold on approval until we have Monica’s guidance.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com, Dr. Aisha Banerjee <aisha@open-civic.org>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-09-23T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: small top-up for summer de-identification pilot

Hi all — reviewed the IRB note. We can offer a 40k-credit promo + a 45-day trial extension (from the date of issuance) under our nonprofit pilot program, contingent on two items:

1) A short one-page usage summary sent back to us after the pilot (metrics: docs processed, false-positive/negative de-id rates).
2) Agreement to our one-page data handling checklist (attached) — ensures PII never leaves their verified pipeline and that only masked outputs are stored.

Cost estimate: using the model you listed (redwood-gpt-4m-instruct) this allocation should cover the finishing pass and validation runs. If you truly need 50k credits we can escalate to a stipend; that requires a quick PO and finance approval (2–3 business days).

I’ve attached a short stub: data_handling_guidelines.pdf. If you can sign/confirm that, I’ll generate the promo and the extension.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Dr. Aisha Banerjee <aisha@open-civic.org>
To: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-09-25T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: small top-up for summer de-identification pilot

Thanks Monica — attaching the IRB_summary.docx and the study grant number (City of Westlake Grant #CW-2028-114) for reference. We can commit to the one-page usage summary and confirm we will keep only masked outputs in our storage.

A few clarifications: we ran the pilot on redwood-gpt-4m-instruct and did 3 validation sweeps per document; our estimate of 50k additional credits assumed a slightly higher validation rate. If you can do 40k credits + 45 days that likely gets us across the finish line; otherwise we will request the stipend option.

Attached: IRB_summary.docx, consent_log.csv (redacted).

— Aisha

From: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Banerjee <aisha@open-civic.org>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2028-10-03T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: small top-up for summer de-identification pilot

Hi Aisha — great, thanks for the quick turn. We will issue a 40,000 credit promo and a 45-day extension. Promo details: promo_code_2028_SCDL_40K (attached as a simple text stub).

Administrative items completed:
- Monica confirmed data checklist reviewed and attached (data_handling_guidelines.pdf).
- Legal confirmed the one-paragraph non-use statement: “Redwood will not use pilot customer data for model training or improvement.” (we will include this on the promo record).
- HubSpot deal created RDW-DEAL-2028-0843 for tracking and internal reporting.

If you prefer a stipend instead of the promo, reply and I’ll route to finance — we have a ~48-hour turnaround on small stipends. Otherwise I’ll ask operations to push the promo live tomorrow and send the redemption instructions.

Congrats on getting this finished under tight timelines — let me know if you’d like a short case study call after your submission to the city.

Best,
Rafael
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

-- Attachment stubs: promo_code_2028_summer_topup.txt (contains promo code string), data_handling_guidelines.pdf, IRB_summary.docx
